notes.title: Content Update #6 - Trade Monsters for Money
notes.content:
It is time for the monster trading market! Sell monsters to other players via gold coins or gems. 100 gems can be bought from me or other players on the Steam community market. If you have at least 100 gems you can also transfer them back out of the game and sell them for money on the Steam community market! So your monsters will have real value now. 100 gems are 1$ (or lower depending on how much others will pay for them on the market).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268867/f3283258a103d8f299605afd9e3a12f2ca0d8162.png[/img]

[b]All changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added monster trading market
[*] You can rename your monsters now
[*] Removed "buy all" option to avoid accidental draining of your entire gold stack when buying sand
[*] Monsters are now tradable (restricted to the ones you caught, hatched/fused ones are not allowed)
[*] Eggs are no longer tradable
[*] Only monsters that you caught will count towards the monster codex catch list
[*] Added info to the monster storage
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the rare gold drop to be a general drop in the infinity gauntlet rewards
[*] Improved loading performance when switching map
[*] Players inside the combat range up to "LEVEL 10 - 20" (displays next to minimap) are in PvP safe zones, aning PvP is disabled there. This is to prevent new players from getting hunted.
[*] Once the enemy tracker reaches a distance of 200 it will only say "PLAYER IS VERY CLOSE" to give players an easier possibility to flee
[*] Added player tracker
[*] Players now spawn near other players
[*] Increased the max. monster storage size by 12 slots
[/list]

notes.title: Release Week Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for trying the game out in the first week! I appreciate all the feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/QdBYFDM2pN]discord[/url]. Here are all the changes over the last week:

- Added 3 new monsters
- Added 2 new attacks (dragon dive + coral shield)
- Added a small icon to already caught monsters so you know which ones you already have
- Increased the monster storage (you can now increase it to up to 24 slots)
- Changed the battle deck system (now it is an actual deck you draw from, previously you just had an equal chance to draw each card, now when you have drawn all cards from your deck it reshuffles it internally)
- Runes can now be sold
- Added special card background to pure effect cards
- You can now look at decks from other players by right clicking them and press "Check Deck"
- Rebalanced cards to make high orb cards more effective
- Hovering over monsters will now display the monster/player name
- Added bonus effects based on deck size (defensive bonus when deck has 13 cards = 10%, 17 cards = 20%, 21 cards = 30%, 25 cards = 40%), this should especially make player versus player fights more strategic and reduce spam decks (although these will still be good for xp farming)
- Fixed a couple of client/server side bugs
- Fixed the graphical issues with AMD GPUs
- Fixed a performance server issue
- Fixed team HP display not being synchronized with actual HP
- Fixed unicorn horn displaying wrong text
- Fixed a crash related to a popup
